rca of the issue: RCA — Frontend infinite 401 loop: On the unauthenticated /login route, the React app issues continuous GET /api/auth/me requests at a rate of ~10/sec (200+ requests captured in 20s). All return 401, which itself is correct backend behavior (test_me_requires_auth passes). The bug is client-side. Three likely causes (in priority order): (1) AuthContext useEffect that calls /me has a state setter inside the effect with that state in its dependency array, causing re-fire each time setUser(null) is called; (2) axios response interceptor on 401 triggers /api/auth/refresh which returns 401 (no refresh cookie on first load) and then retries /me unconditionally — classic refresh-retry loop without a 'isRefreshing' flag or attempted flag on the original request; (3) useWebSocket attempts to connect, gets 'anonymous', updates state, which re-mounts AuthContext consumers and re-calls /me. Mitigation: in api.js 401 interceptor, mark originalRequest._retry=true before calling /refresh, and on refresh failure: do NOT retry, just resolve setUser(null) once. In AuthContext, fetch /me only inside a useEffect with empty deps [], and on 401 set loading=false and user=null without re-triggering. In useWebSocket, only connect when authenticated user exists. Reproduction: open https://alpha-trading-3.preview.emergentagent.com/login, open devtools Network tab — observe continuous /api/auth/me 401 requests; page body stays black.
